reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's v6 (full ladder) model — port of tools/ladder2.py: refit per-platform K_us, per-platform median sample lag, and per-segment static steering offset on the canonical Ford segments, then predicted yaw rate via v*(delta+off)/(L+K*v^2) with the per-platform sample shift.
notes: V6 (full ladder) reconstructed end-to-end on canonical data: per-platform K_us refit (0.00073, 0.00282), per-platform sample lag ({'FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1': 4, 'FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1': 3}), per-segment steering offset. v6 fits per-segment offset on the same data scored against (~1 DOF/segment), so this number is in-sample and likely flatters; agent's REPORT acknowledges this. Canonical filter is v_mps>2.0 (looser than agent's |a_lat|<15 & v>5 fit mask); stuck a_lat sensor samples therefore stay in scoring pool.
